# ufw Provider

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "ufw" {
  host     = "192.168.1.100"
  username = "root"
  password = "mySecr3tP4ssw0Rd"
}

resource "ufw_status" "status" {
  enabled = true

  # enable ufw only when ssh is allowed
  depends_on = [ufw_rule.allow_ssh]
}

resource "ufw_rule" "allow_ssh" {
  action   = "allow"
  protocol = "tcp"
  port     = 22
  comment  = "Allow SSH"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Host Url
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `username` (String)

### Optional

- `port` (Number)
